body: Releasing gqlkit or gqlkit-sdl: update the CHANGELOG first, then push TWO tags on the release commit: the @ tag (gqlkit@vX.Y.Z / gqlkit-sdl@vX.Y.Z) is the release GoReleaser builds, the slash tag (gqlkit/vX.Y.Z / gqlkit-sdl/vX.Y.Z) is the Go module version tag go get/go install resolve. Since 2026-10-13 every workflow is workflow_dispatch only (Actions minutes are a budget), so pushing a tag does NOT release: run gh workflow run release-gqlkit.yml --ref gqlkit@vX.Y.Z (release-gqlkit-sdl.yml for sdl); it must be dispatched on the tag because it reads GITHUB_REF. Never move a slash tag once pushed (the Go proxy caches it forever); cut a new patch instead. gqlkit-ts: bump package.json, push parity tag gqlkit-ts@vX.Y.Z, npm publish with OTP from 1Password item 'npmjs.com' via a temp --userconfig session plus npm logout, never ~/.npmrc. Re-pin example go.mod files after a release.
